description: Schlock safety validation and session setup hooks. The PreToolUse/Bash command blocks (exit 2) unless the hook both exits 0 and prints a decision, so a hook that cannot start, or starts something other than the hook, blocks the tool call; see tests/test_hook_manifest.py

hooks.command: out=$(python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre_tool_use.py") || exit 2; case $out in *'"permissionDecision"'*) printf '%s\n' "$out" ;; *) echo 'schlock: pre_tool_use.py returned no decision' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
